title: German-Style Crispy Wrap
description: A crispy Ukrainian-style wrap filled with kissed avocado, inspired by traditional German flavors.
instructions: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the crispy fried onions until golden brown, set aside.
Cut the Ukrainian-style wrap in half, toast in the pan until crispy.
Mash the avocado in a bowl and season with salt.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the mashed avocado on the toasted wrap.
Top with cooked crispy fried onions and a dollop of sour cream.
